events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) has his right arm in a vertical position contesting the layup attempt by Landale (HOU) and the marginal contact is created by Landale extending his right arm.
Landale (HOU) establishes himself in Jones' (SAS) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.
Green (HOU) engages and quickly disengages with Wembanyama (SAS) off-ball.
Brooks (HOU) contests Sochan's (SAS) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.

Jones (SAS) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Green (HOU) as Green dribbles toward the pick. Jones then brings his right hand forward and marginal contact occurs with Green's right arm as Green attempts to re-gain control of the ball.
Green (HOU) and Sochan (SAS) make incidental body contact with one another as they each elevate for the rebound.
Green (HOU) brings his left arm toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Sochan's (SAS) left arm prior to the start of Sochan's upward shooting motion.
Brooks (HOU) extends his right hand and forearm into Sochan's (SAS) side, altering Sochan's trajectory during his upward shooting motion.
Sochan (SAS) brings his left leg outward toward VanVleet's (HOU) path and marginal contact occurs with VanVleet's upper body as he starts his dribble.
Champagnie (SAS) slightly extends laterally prior to marginal body contact occurring with VanVleet (HOU) along the baseline.
Houston obtains possession of the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Vassell (SAS) commits a take foul on Holiday (HOU).
Jones (SAS) commits a take foul on Green (HOU).
VanVleet (HOU) commits a take foul on Jones (SAS).
VanVleet (HOU) and Jones (SAS) come together at the same spot during the inbound and incidental contact occurs prior to Jones tripping over his teammate's foot.
Wembanyama (SAS) commits a take foul on Holiday (HOU).
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on Vassell (SAS). The contact occurs prior to the start of Vassell's upward shooting motion.
Collins (SAS) brings his hands toward Thompson's (HOU) side and marginal contact occurs as Thompson gains control of the rebound.
Collins (SAS) and Smith Jr. (HOU) momentarily engage with one another and marginal contact occurs prior to Smith Jr. losing his balance on his own in the lane.
